QUOTE: Two build options run those tests under detectors: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (clang MemorySanitizer) and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` (memcheck).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the MemSan/valgrind test options but never says the facility is off-by-default or explicitly not part of the library API.
